# Worklogs

<!-- auto-generated by cmd/docgen — do not edit -->

Log, list, and manage time spent on Jira issues. Worklogs feed into time
tracking reports and sprint velocity.

Time values use Jira notation: `1w` (1 week = 5 days), `1d` (1 day = 8 hours),
`1h` (1 hour), `30m` (30 minutes), or combined: `1h30m`, `2d4h`.

## jira worklog add

Log work on an issue.

**Alias:** `jira issue worklog add`

### Usage

```
jira worklog add <issue-key> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--time` | `-t` | Time spent (e.g. `1h30m`, `2d`, `45m`) |
| `--started` | | When work started (default: now); format `2006-01-02T15:04:05-0700` |
| `--comment` | `-b` | Worklog comment |
| `--remaining` | | Set remaining estimate after logging (e.g. `2h`) |
| `--adjust-auto` | | Auto-adjust remaining estimate (subtract logged time) |
| `--adjust-manual` | | Manually set remaining estimate with `--remaining` |

### Inherited Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--context` | `-c` | Active Jira context name |
| `--json` | | Output in JSON format |
| `--yaml` | | Output in YAML format |

### Examples

```bash
# Log 2 hours and 30 minutes
jira worklog add MYPROJ-42 --time 2h30m

# Log with a comment
jira worklog add MYPROJ-42 --time 1h --comment "Implemented feature X"

# Log for yesterday
jira worklog add MYPROJ-42 --time 8h --started 2024-01-15T09:00:00+0100

# Log and auto-adjust remaining estimate
jira worklog add MYPROJ-42 --time 3h --adjust-auto

# Log and set remaining estimate manually
jira worklog add MYPROJ-42 --time 2h --adjust-manual --remaining 4h
```

## jira worklog list

List worklogs for an issue.

**Alias:** `jira issue worklog list`, `ls`

### Usage

```
jira worklog list <issue-key> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | `-L` | Maximum worklogs to display (default 25) |
| `--author` | | Filter by author (account ID or `me`) |

### Examples

```bash
jira worklog list MYPROJ-42
jira worklog list MYPROJ-42 --author me --json
```

---

## jira worklog delete

Delete a worklog entry.

**Alias:** `jira issue worklog delete`

### Usage

```
jira worklog delete <issue-key> <worklog-id> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--confirm` | | Skip confirmation prompt |
| `--adjust-auto` | | Auto-adjust remaining estimate |
| `--adjust-manual` | | Manually set remaining estimate |
| `--remaining` | | New remaining estimate (with `--adjust-manual`) |

### Examples

```bash
jira worklog delete MYPROJ-42 10001
jira worklog delete MYPROJ-42 10001 --confirm
jira worklog delete MYPROJ-42 10001 --confirm --adjust-auto
```
